findings.mechanism: ADC sampling can exchange charge with C1 and change the output trajectory. The disturbance and recovery depend on the missing sampling parameters; bare RC connectivity and rule checks do not bound them.
findings.reasoning: The unloaded, initially discharged nominal circuit gives 1−exp(−1)=0.632120559 V at 1 ms, with 12.12 mV lower-bound margin. That establishes the unloaded baseline only. Even the simplified fast charge-sharing limit depends on ADC capacitance and initial voltage. Neither compliance nor failure while connected to the unspecified ADC is established.
